humanData.source: human-data/data/study1.csv, study2.csv, study3.csv: trial-level data of Burton, Harris, Shah & Hahn (2022), 100 UK Prolific participants x 51 events per study (5,100 trials each); supplied with the project, no codebook file.

missing.reason: The data files do not record whether E1 or eBR was asked first, so the two order arms cannot be separated. Each participant is loaded once per study with arm = condition = the study id ('study1', 'study2', 'study3').
